Bodelschwinghsche Stiftungen Bethel in Bielefeld, part of the PIKSL network ('Personenzentrierte Interaktion und Kommunikation für mehr Selbstbestimmung im Leben') coordinated by the nonprofit In der Gemeinde leben gGmbH in Düsseldorf. Three days a week, people with and without disabilities can use computers, tablets and the internet free of charge, get support from an inclusive team, and attend courses and workshops on using digital devices and the internet safely.
